preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 100,000.
The sum of edge weights s must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.
The number of edges must be exactly n - 1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: All vertices in the edges must be valid indices between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(a != b for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: No edge can connect a vertex to itself.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum possible diameter of the tree as a string.
The output must be within a relative error of 1e-6 compared to the calculated minimum diameter.
